ADMINISTRATIVE APPEALS TRIBUNAL

[2021] AATA 1234

TRIBUNAL MEMBER: Deputy President S Smith

DATE OF DECISION: 3 March 2021

CATCHWORDS

LEGISLATION

DECISION
The Tribunal remits the matter to the Minister for reconsideration.
